name: Closing: blue professional
description: A centred close: two concentric thin rings behind, a short blue rule, one closing headline, a short explanation, a solid blue pill button as the call to action, and contact details on the last line. A thank-you page would lose the act of handing the next step to the audience.

title.hint: closing claim, one line, up to 16 characters

body.hint: an explanation of 1 to 2 lines, up to 50 characters

cta.hint: the main call to action, a short phrase, up to 12 characters

caption.hint: contact details or the next meeting time, one line

body.value: Fix the three delivery problems this quarter, and next quarter has room for new things.

caption.value: Data and appendix in the shared folder, updated an hour after the meeting
